$\bullet$ Bag $Y$ contains 6 green marbles and 5 blue marbles
A marble is selected at random from bag $X$ and placed in bag $Y$
A second marble is selected at random from bag $X$ and placed in bag $Y$
A third marble is then selected, this time from bag $Y$

parts.label: b

parts.text:
(ii) Two events, $C$ and $D$, are such that

$\mathrm{P}(C)=\frac{x}{x+5}$ $\quad \mathrm{P}(D)=\frac{5}{x}$

where $x$ is a positive constant.
By considering $\mathrm{P}(C)+\mathrm{P}(D)$ show that $C$ and $D$ cannot be mutually exclusive. (4)
parts.mark_scheme:
(ii) M1: For an attempt to add $\mathrm{P}(C)$ and $\mathrm{P}(D)$ e.g. $\frac{x^2}{x(x+5)}+\frac{5(x+5)}{x(x+5)}$. May be implied by $\frac{x^2+5x+25}{x^2+5x}$ or $1-\frac{5}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}$
$\frac{x}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}=\frac{x^2+5(x+5)}{x(x+5)}$ or $\frac{x}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}=\frac{x+5-5}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}$
M1: For $\frac{x^2+5x+25}{x^2+5x}$ oe or $1-\frac{5}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}$
$=\frac{x^2+5x+25}{x^2+5x}$ oe or $=1-\frac{5}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}$
A1: for recognising that $\mathrm{P}(C)+\mathrm{P}(D)$ is $>1$
$=1+\frac{25}{x^2+5x}$ or as $x^2+5x+25>x^2+5x$ then $\mathrm{P}(C)+\mathrm{P}(D)>1$ or As $x+5>x$ then $\frac{5}{x+5}<\frac{5}{x}\Rightarrow -\frac{5}{x+5}+\frac{5}{x}>0$ So $\mathrm{P}(C)+\mathrm{P}(D)>1$

$\mathrm{P}(C\cup D)>1$ or $\mathrm{P}(C\cap D)>0$

questions.stem: The lengths, $L$ mm, of housefly wings are normally distributed with $L \sim \mathrm{N}(4.5, 0.4^2)$

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Find the probability that a randomly selected housefly has a wing length of less than 3.86 mm. (3)
parts.mark_scheme:

$=\mathrm{P}(Z<-1.6)=1-0.9452$ or $1-0.945200...=0.0548$ awrt 0.0548

parts.label: b
parts.text:

(i) the upper quartile ($Q_3$) of $L$
(ii) the lower quartile ($Q_1$) of $L$ (4)

A value that is greater than $Q_3+1.5\times(Q_3-Q_1)$ or smaller than $Q_1-1.5\times(Q_3-Q_1)$ is defined as an outlier.
